# Safariyat (سفريات)

> Safariyat (Arabic: سفريات, sometimes transliterated "Safriyat") is an Arabic-language online travel platform for booking flights and hotels at https://www.safariyat.live. Users search real-time flight offers from hundreds of airlines, compare prices, book, and pay securely online with instant e-ticket confirmation. The interface is Arabic-first (RTL) with English support.

## What Safariyat offers

- Flight booking (حجز طيران): search one-way and round-trip flights, compare fares across airlines, book and receive an e-ticket instantly: https://www.safariyat.live/flights
- Hotel booking (حجز فنادق): compare hotel prices and deals in popular destinations: https://www.safariyat.live/hotels
- Manage bookings, cancellations, and refunds online; refunds are processed automatically to the original payment method when fare rules allow.
- Secure online payment; a booking is only confirmed after payment is verified.
- 24/7 customer support: https://www.safariyat.live/support

## Key facts

- Brand name: سفريات (Safariyat)
- Website: https://www.safariyat.live
- Languages: Arabic (primary), English
- Category: Online travel agency (OTA) — flights and hotels
